title: 🔥 NEW AGE SPIRITUALITY, HOROSCOPES, TAROT CARDS—OPENING DOORS TO DEMONS! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 NEW AGE SPIRITUALITY, HOROSCOPES, TAROT CARDS—OPENING DOORS TO DEMONS! 🔥
📖 Deuteronomy 18:10-12 – "Let no one be found among you who sacrifices their son or daughter in the fire, who practices divination or sorcery, interprets omens, engages in witchcraft, or casts spells, or who is a medium or spiritist or who consults the dead. Anyone who does these things is detestable to the Lord."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, my friends believe in astrology and tarot card readings, saying it’s just for fun. They don’t see anything wrong with horoscopes, manifestation, or energy healing. Is this really dangerous, or are Christians just overreacting?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Today, millions are turning to New Age practices, astrology, tarot cards, and so-called "spiritual enlightenment." What seems like innocent fun is actually a direct doorway for demonic activity.
🚨 The Bible gives us serious warnings about these practices—let’s expose the truth!

🔥 1. SATAN DISGUISES HIS LIES AS ‘HARMLESS FUN’
📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 – "Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light."
Most people don’t realize that New Age spirituality, horoscopes, and tarot cards are rooted in witchcraft.

✔️ They think it’s about "energy" and "vibes"—but it’s actually demonic deception.
✔️ They believe it’s just "self-discovery"—but it’s actually seeking guidance from demons.
✔️ They say it’s "just for fun"—but in the spiritual realm, it is deadly serious!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Would you play with a loaded gun and say, "It’s just for fun"?
👉 Messing with the occult is even more dangerous—because it destroys your soul!
🚨 SATAN WANTS YOU TO THINK IT’S HARMLESS—BUT IT’S A TRAP!

🔥 2. HOROSCOPES AND ASTROLOGY—WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?
📖 Isaiah 47:13-14 – "All the counsel you have received has only worn you out! Let your astrologers come forward, those stargazers who make predictions month by month, let them save you from what is coming upon you. Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up."
🚨 Astrology is NOT just a personality test—it is divination, which the Bible condemns!

✔️ Horoscopes tell you to trust the stars instead of God.
✔️ Astrology makes you believe your future is controlled by birth dates, not by God’s will.
✔️ Many people let horoscopes determine their relationships, decisions, and self-worth!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a person checks their horoscope every day but never reads the Bible, who are they really putting their trust in?
👉 It’s idolatry—giving glory to creation instead of the Creator!
🔥 DO NOT TRUST THE STARS—TRUST THE GOD WHO MADE THEM!

🔥 3. TAROT CARDS AND PSYCHICS—A DIRECT LINE TO DEMONS!
📖 Leviticus 19:31 – "Do not turn to mediums or seek out spiritists, for you will be defiled by them. I am the Lord your God."
🚨 Tarot cards, psychic readings, and fortune-telling are forms of WITCHCRAFT.
🔥 WHEN YOU SEEK KNOWLEDGE FROM ANY SOURCE OTHER THAN GOD, YOU INVITE DEMONS!

✔️ Psychics and tarot card readers claim to ‘see the future’—but only God knows the future! (Isaiah 46:9-10)
✔️ They may say they receive ‘messages from spirits’—but those spirits are DEMONIC!
✔️ Even if a psychic is "accurate," that does NOT mean they are from God! (Deuteronomy 13:1-3)

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
King Saul consulted a medium instead of trusting God—and it led to his DESTRUCTION! (1 Samuel 28:7-19)
👉 Do not make the same mistake—DO NOT SEEK GUIDANCE FROM DEMONS!
🚨 NO MATTER HOW ‘HARMLESS’ IT SEEMS, GOD CALLS IT AN ABOMINATION!

🔥 4. THE DANGER OF MANIFESTATION & LAW OF ATTRACTION
📖 Proverbs 3:5 – "Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding."
🚨 The "law of attraction" teaches that YOU have the power to create your reality.

❌ "If you just think positive thoughts, you will attract good things."
❌ "If you visualize success, the universe will give it to you."
❌ "You don’t need prayer—just manifest what you want!"
🔥 THIS IS SATAN’S LIE—BECAUSE IT REMOVES GOD FROM THE PICTURE!

✔️ The universe doesn’t give blessings—GOD DOES! (James 1:17)
✔️ You are not in control of destiny—GOD IS! (Jeremiah 29:11)
✔️ If you trust in your own "power," you are rejecting GOD’S power!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man decides to "manifest wealth" but never prays to God.
👉 Who is he really trusting? Himself—not God!
🔥 DO NOT PUT FAITH IN THE UNIVERSE—PUT FAITH IN JESUS!

🔥 5. HOW TO CLOSE THE DOORS YOU’VE OPENED TO DEMONS
📖 James 4:7 – "Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you."
🚨 If you have ever practiced New Age spirituality, horoscopes, tarot cards, or manifestation, YOU MUST RENOUNCE IT NOW!

✔️ 1. REPENT IMMEDIATELY! (Acts 3:19)
📖 "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out."
🔥 Ask God for forgiveness and turn away from these practices!

✔️ 2. DESTROY ALL OCCULT ITEMS! (Acts 19:19)
📖 "A number who had practiced sorcery brought their scrolls together and burned them publicly."
🔥 If you have tarot cards, astrology books, or New Age crystals—BURN THEM!

✔️ 3. PRAY FOR DELIVERANCE! (Luke 10:19)
📖 "I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy."
🔥 If you’ve opened a demonic doorway, ask Jesus to break every spiritual chain!

✔️ 4. READ THE BIBLE DAILY! (Psalm 119:105)
📖 "Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path."
🔥 The ONLY source of truth is GOD’S WORD—fill your mind with Scripture!

✔️ 5. WARN OTHERS! (Ephesians 5:11)
📖 "Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them."
🔥 Many people are trapped in deception—SHARE THE TRUTH!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: CHOOSE JESUS, NOT DEMONIC DECEPTION!
📖 John 14:6 – "Jesus answered, ‘I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’"

🚨 THERE ARE ONLY TWO CHOICES:
❌ Follow New Age deception and open doors to demons.
✔️ Follow Jesus Christ and live in truth, peace, and salvation!

👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
✔️ Destroy all demonic connections today?
❌ Or continue in deception and risk your soul?
🚨 DO NOT PLAY WITH DARKNESS—RUN TO JESUS NOW!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO RENOUNCE NEW AGE SPIRITUALITY
"Lord Jesus, I repent for every time I have participated in astrology, tarot cards, manifestation, or any occult practice. I renounce all connections to the enemy and choose to follow You alone! Break every demonic chain in my life and fill me with Your Holy Spirit. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"
